title: Accessible project handoff
deliverable: Deliver a small accessible landing page with a contact form and reproducible validation output.

criteria.requirement: The contact form must associate a visible Email label with an email input using matching for and id attributes.
The form must include a native submit button reachable in normal keyboard tab order, without a negative tabindex.
The email input must use type=email and the required attribute to prevent an empty submission.

evidence_rules: Assess the complete HTML artifact embedded in the submitted UTF-8 document. The exact HTML attributes are primary evidence. Test assertions alone cannot override the HTML. This pilot uses synthetic artifacts and has no payment transfer.
